The '''news anchor''' is a character {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
The news anchor is a pre-War newscaster who was mainly shown reporting on current [[United States of America|American events]].

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The End (episode)|The End]]===
On the morning of the [[Great War]], the news anchor is seen on the [[Spencer residence|Spencer household]]'s [[Television|television set]], talking about the failure of peace negotiations between the United States and [[China]] at [[Anchorage]], [[State#Alaska|Alaska]]. He continued to talk about the specter of nuclear war which had faced the U.S. over the past ten years, but his broadcast was then turned off by [[Ronda Spencer]], who wanted to avoid bad news to focus on the party for her son [[Roy Spencer]].

===[[The Trap]]===
At an earlier time before the Great War, the news anchor is seen on television in a bar in [[Los Angeles]], talking about a shortage of [[uranium]] and increasing competition between nations over control of the resource. Because of this, the news anchor indicates that energy prices could surge in the upcoming winter, while also causing an expansion to the ongoing war. He tells his audience that his broadcast will continue after a word from his network's newest sponsor.

==Personality==
The news anchor portrayed himself as a calm and professional person who calmly delivered the news despite the imminent possibility of nuclear war.

==Appearances==
The news anchor appears only {{in|FOTV}}.
